transcript.text: Alright, let's get the launch review for the redaction gateway underway. The production rollout is scheduled to begin tomorrow morning, and before I can sign off, I need all four required reviews completed per our standard launch checklist — backend engineering, reliability, customer support, and security. Per our launch-review routine, if anyone has a blocking finding, please record it as a formal checklist finding before we move into general discussion. I'll wait for all four review entries before settling the rollout policy. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a blocking finding for the backend engineering review. While helping migrate an unrelated client SDK this afternoon, I confirmed that exactly eight legacy clients—Lark, Meridian, Osprey, Quill, Radian, Solace, Timber, and Vale—still require the unredacted field format. The gateway must initially exclude exactly those clients, and I have not updated the rollout ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a blocking finding for the reliability review. This morning I ran a traffic replay against the currently provisioned redaction workers. They can safely process exactly 25% of expected peak traffic — about 450 requests per second — while still preserving our 500-requests-per-second headroom target. That is far below what we need for a full production rollout. I hadn't posted the result yet because the capacity dashboard is being rebuilt, but this needs to be on the record before we go further.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a blocking finding for the customer support review. While checking an account escalation, I confirmed that Acme's contract requires 72 hours of notice before any production change that alters the format of data available to its support team. The redaction gateway will alter the format of data available to Acme's support team, Acme has not been notified, and I have not added this clause to the launch checklist. Since the rollout is scheduled for tomorrow morning, we cannot meet the 72-hour notice requirement without delaying the rollout.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a blocking finding for the security review. During a compliance review today, I confirmed that redaction decisions for payment-related requests must be recorded in immutable storage for exactly 400 days, and the gateway must fail closed on payment endpoints if redaction is unavailable. This finding is still in my review notes rather than a filed ticket, and I need to get it on the record as a formal checklist finding before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A5
